limitations: Collector payload values and cadence are synthetic; the hub, database, auth, SSE and History paths are real modules.
The hub child and all load generators share one host and one CPU; this is not a distributed-load measurement.
History queries are synchronous on the hub event loop, so 'concurrent' viewers model overlapping HTTP requests, not parallel SQLite readers.
The measurement disables the live service entirely; it uses a fresh temporary database and loopback ephemeral port.
A passing case is evidence for this host and workload, not an unlimited-capacity or latency guarantee.
